name: Carved Mourner
source: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
description: The carving weeps. Its tears turn to a mist that covers the halls.
disable: DC 17 Religion check (trained) to recite prayers for the dead, or DC 14 Dwarven-lore check to speak the history of Raseri Kanton, or DC 20 Thievery check to plug the holes in the carving

offensiveAbilities.name: Weep for Raseri Kanton
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature looks at the carved mourner

Effect The hallways fill with a thick mist. When the mist first appears, all living creatures in area A take 1d6 void damage (DC 17 basic Fortitude save), and all undead creatures regain 1d6 healing Hit Points. All creatures within the mist become Concealed. This mist lasts for 1 hour or until the haunt is disabled.
